notes: First real, logged LLM-agent baseline run against the live server/app.py FastAPI server (not a hypothetical).
Each task was run once, single-shot, no retries, as its own process invocation: `python inference.py <task_id>`.
Raw [START]/[STEP]/[END] logs for each run are checked in under results/logs/.

Running this baseline surfaced a real grading bug in structural_design_env/env.py: forced episode termination after 5 consecutive invalid actions set done=True without computing info['graded_score'], so the client-observed score silently defaulted to 0.0 even when a real nonzero grade existed. Fixed in the same change that produced this baseline (see tests/test_env.py::TestForcedTerminationGrading); these results were captured after the fix.

results.observed_failure_mode: Agent repeatedly retried the same invalid add_wall/upgrade_section actions (duplicate walls, sections already at HEB400 max) instead of adapting to the error message, burning most of its step budget without ever sending 'done'.
Same loop-on-invalid-action pattern as task2_office (repeated add_wall on existing walls, repeated upgrade_section past HEB400 max), never reaching 'done'.

summary.headline_finding: gpt-4o-mini with a single-shot, no-retry-adaptation prompt solves the easy warehouse task reasonably (score 0.301, valid, 5 steps) but degrades sharply on the harder multi-floor tasks with lateral loads (office 0.142, hospital 0.043): in both harder tasks the agent got stuck repeating the same rejected action instead of trying a different one, consuming its entire step budget without ever signaling completion.
